# Photoshop MCP local-only fork

> Local stdio automation for Photoshop on Windows and macOS, with ordinary tools, 16 local recipes and 20 prompt templates. Custom JSX and recorded actions remain available.

Run this checkout's compiled server: `node /absolute/path/photoshop-mcp/dist/index.js`.
Do not replace it with the upstream npm distribution.

Runtime statistics, standalone cloud chat, account/API-key validation and built-in Firefly/Neural Filter/native-sky operations are disabled. Direct requests to blocked tools return `cloud_disabled` before Adobe dispatch. Use content-aware fill, ordinary retouching and local image compositing.

Select Subject and automatic background removal require Photoshop Image Processing set to Device. All custom scripts and recorded actions must follow the same local-only instruction. Their execution remains unsandboxed; this is not a guarantee that arbitrary code cannot bypass guidance. Adobe's background/login behavior and the host model are outside this policy.
